desc: Formalize the characterization: achievable in-degree vectors = c in {0,1,2}^N (cycle part, alternating 0/2 pattern) plus x_i in {0,1} on spokes; hub degree determined.
Find the counting reduction: distinct in-degree sequences of orientations of G = T_G(2,1) = number of forests of G (verified on trees, cycles, parallel edges, and sample 1 = 14).
Derive O(N) DP: 5-state connectivity DP around the cycle for forest counting, reduced to 4 states (a,b,c,d) with explicit transitions T0/T1; verified by hand on sample 1 (14) and all-zero C_3 (7).
Implement final Python solution with the 4-state O(N) DP, reading stdin and writing answer to stdout.
Validate by brute force for small N (exhaustive orientation enumeration, N <= ~12): all strings for N=3..8 and 200 random strings each for N=9..12 match; both samples (14 and 261339902) verified.
